name: Weiden in der Oberpfalz (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided green over red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Weiden in der Oberpfalz (a yellow lion on black, Bavarian lozenges and a willow tree on red).
history: Municipal flag of Weiden in der Oberpfalz; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Weiden arms — lion, lozenges and willow
